methodology.order: odd pair baseline/current; even pair current/baseline

shared.admission: actual previewDemands().privateReads; download queued after initial two geometry pages; same in-memory fixture

methodology.warmup: each production geometry reader consumes an 8 MiB memory prefix; each workspace reader consumes one 2 MiB local page, all before recorded samples
methodology.local: real readGeometrySource -> readWorkspacePreview -> descriptor-relative workspace open and fs.read; recently written local file, no cold-cache claim
methodology.controlled: in-memory page copies with artificial per-read timer delay, not measured network latency
methodology.stages: page and fs.read callback spans are overlapping interval unions, not additive waterfall segments; outside spans include scheduling, validation, copying, yielding, admission and instrumentation; they do not isolate assembly CPU
methodology.memory: 5 ms sampled process RSS/heap/external/arrayBuffers with start/end samples; sampled maxima are not exact peaks
methodology.temporaryDisk: one fixture only, at most 200 MiB; removed in finally; no tested production file writes
